decisions.reason: The source changes the token identifier shown in mint-result feedback; it does not change the required USDC approval-to-mint flow.
The token identifier displayed after minting does not change which payment methods are available, disclosed, or selectable.
The source reports a USDC-path feedback defect and does not change the ETH wallet mint requirement.
Correcting the token ID in success feedback does not change mint pricing or revenue allocation.
The source concerns feedback after connected-wallet USDC approval and does not necessarily change the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow or its mint destination.
The displayed token identifier has no effect on ETH pricing, swap behavior, or excess-payment refunds.
The mint-result token identifier does not alter the optional gratuity feature or its configured amounts.
Showing the current confirmed token ID does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The source changes popup behavior and does not request any revision to FAQ copy, including its separate description of confirmation emails.
The token ID shown in mint-success feedback does not change which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
Mint-result feedback does not affect ebook rendering, entry points, sizing, or navigation.
The source concerns a transactional success popup and does not change landing-page content or layout.
